scope: Supplemental actual C++ desktop API carrier for one existing frozen assertion only; no new product, interface or family acceptance
decision: Permit a separately identified direct C++ Window API carrier for config.workflow_delta. Window currently owns the actual recording flag and cumulative workflow log; the headless native Settings/Profile API has no workflow owner. Establish recording with a genuine accepted image action, then observe complete actual workflow state before and after applied shortcut configuration and a refused configuration.
narrow_exception: The supplemental carrier may include the existing internal C++ desktop Window header and link the desktop library without creating an ImGui context or renderer. The public-only installed SDK S01-S04 must still exclude private, GUI and Python headers/dependencies. This exception does not apply to any other assertion or export desktop dependencies through imagejxx::core.
required_evidence: Exactly one named CW01.configuration_workflow_no_effects API case, distinct from the existing seven Window groups and all H/K input scenarios
A real recording-enabled image edit produces a nonempty workflow record and an actual native pixel/history change before configuration
Actual complete workflow values, settings/profile, native identity/revisions/history and owned preferences before/after configuration
Typed config.workflow_delta derived from actual log lengths and complete log equality; no literal zero or surrogate metadata owner
Independent comparison to the unchanged frozen expected integer zero with exact test/source/executable/core/desktop provenance
Retained installed public-only SDK S01-S04 and all other 66 C++ assertions remain required at their original scope
preservation: All eight frozen shortcut contracts, 67 cpp_api assertions, previous requirements, proofs and manifest bytes remain unchanged
Do not relabel imgui_cpp input evidence as direct cpp_api execution
SessionCapture workflow codec data and arbitrary metadata do not provide a live recorder
The current native recording-ownership gap remains required under the full controller/automation plan
